# optimizelycmp_content_type (Data Source)

Looks up one content type by name. It fails if there is no match or more than one.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "optimizelycmp_content_type" "article" {
  name = "Article"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Content type name (case-insensitive exact match).

### Read-Only

- `component` (Boolean)
- `disabled` (Boolean)
- `id` (String) ID of the content type.
